name: Italian Brainrot Who
description: Experience the Most Addictive Brain-Teaser Game—Italian Brainrot Who!In this casual puzzle and online guessing game, you'll put your wits to the test by identifying the most iconic meme characters from the Italian brainrot era. From the unforgettable 'Bombardino Crocodilo' to the hypnotic 'tung tung tung Sahur,' every mystery awaits your discovery. Level up your meme knowledge and become the ultimate Italian Brainrot Who champion!
controls:
Controls

    Move your character with the WASD keys. Sprint by double-tapping A or D
    Collect resources by clicking and holding on to nearby blocks or creatures. Use the right tools for the right job
    Place blocks by selecting a block in your Hotbar and right-clicking on an empty space in the world
    Open your inventory by pressing E. Here, you can craft items and equip armor
    Use an item or eat food by selecting the item in your Hotbar and right-clicking and holding. You can review and change your controls in the settings menu.

comments.content: This game is so addictive! I can't stop playing it 😂 The Bombardino Crocodilo level had me laughing for hours!
Finally a game that understands Italian brainrot culture! 🧠🇮🇹 The meme references are spot on.
Spent my entire weekend playing this. No regrets! 🎮 The tung tung tung Sahur level is my favorite!
Controls are a bit confusing at first but once you get the hang of it, it's super fun! 👍
As someone who loves Italian brainrot memes, this game is PERFECT! 💯 Can't wait for more levels!
My kids introduced me to this game and now I'm hooked! Great family fun 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
The difficulty curve is perfect! Each level gets progressively more challenging 🧩 Love it!

name: Italian Brainrot: Picture Builder
description: Get ready for a fun and addictive Italian brainrot-style puzzle game! In this creative experience, you'll drag and drop pieces to assemble charming Italian animal characters, inspired by the viral Italian brainrot animals list trend. Each level introduces a brand-new character to unlock and collect.This game is perfect for fans of quirky, viral aesthetics and lighthearted brain challenges. Whether you're into tier lists, memes, or just love animals, this is the ideal brainrot brain game for you!
controls:
Controls

    Tap and drag puzzle pieces from the bottom of the screen
    Drop them into the correct position to complete the picture
    If the piece is correct, it will snap into place automatically
    No timers or pressure — play at your own pace

One of the best puzzle games I've played this year. Simple concept but executed perfectly! 👏

name: Sprunki Italian Brainrot
description: Mine Blocks is a 2D Minecraft fan action game originally released in Flash. You can now play the game again, as it's been rebuilt in HTML5 and features regular updates from the development team. Explore, craft, and create a world of your imaginings in this open-world playground!
controls: Click and hold any clothing item or accessory, then drag it onto your Sprunki to dress them.
